html:
The Dawnsdrop Pickaxe is an addition to the Dawnsdrop Tools custom content added in Patch 1.3.2. These pickaxes can be equipped and used for a short duration with a long cooldown to improve yield from regular mining. The duration and cooldown goes up and gets reduced respectively as you improve the Grade of the pickaxe.

Grade Effect

Grade Buff Duration Cooldown
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 60s 120min
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 114s 100min
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 165s 90min
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 222s 80min
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 276s 70min
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe 330s 60min

Credit to Discord user ben.ceu for collecting these.

Starting the Questline

Requirements: 230,000 Mining Proficiency

Bring Dawnsdrop Gloves.

  1. Go to Glitterstone (Ynystere Community Center).
  2. Mine an Iron Vein with your Gloves equipped for the Dawnsdrop Buff.
  3. Get the quest from Tilu in the Community Center.
Summary
Quest Grade Required Items Labor Spend
1. The Art of Mining Grand — —
2. Digging Deeper Grand Iron Ore × 3,000 —
3. Tool for the Job Rare — Mining × 20,000
4. Glint of Copper Rare Copper Ore × 3,000 · Silver Ore × 3,000 —
5. Elemental Heart Arcane Collect Elemental Heart × 1 from Arkanis the Destroyer in Greater Kroloal Cradle —
6. The Ember-forged Tool Heroic — Mining × 30,000
7. Glitter and Gold Heroic Gold Ore × 3,000 —
8. Sparks of Creation Heroic Collect Infernal Anima × 1 from Sirothe the Infernal in Serpentis —
9. Ore of Origins Unique Archeum Ore × 2,000 —
10. Tempered by the Flame Unique — Mining × 30,000
11. Essence of Purity Celestial Pure Iron Ore × 200 —
12. Further Refinement (final) Celestial Craft 1× Dawnsdrop Pickaxe:
Dawnsdrop Pickaxe (Unique) × 1 · Pure Iron Ore × 100 · Archeum Ingot × 20 · Copper Ingot × 100 · Iron Ingot × 300

Grand Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

1. The Art of Mining

Turn in at Thadius, the Blacksmith in Glitterstone.

2. Digging Deeper

  • Collect 3000 Iron Ore.

You can purchase these straight from the Auction House.

Rare Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

3. Tool for the Job

  • Use 20,000 Labor in Mining.

4. Glint of Copper

  • Collect 3000 Copper Ore.
  • Collect 3000 Silver Ore.

You can purchase these straight from the Auction House.

Arcane Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

5. Elemental Heart

  • Kill Arkanis the Destroyer and collect the Elemental Heart in Greater Kroloal Cradle.

Tip: Bring Enervate (Witchcraft) and other heal reduction debuffs in order to defeat the first boss in GKC.

Heroic Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

6. The Ember-forged Tool

  • Use 30,000 Labor in Mining.

7. Glitter and Gold

  • Collect 3000 Gold Ore.

You can purchase these straight from the Auction House.

8. Sparks of Creation

  • Kill Sirothe and collect the Infernal Anima in Serpentis.

Unique Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

9. Ore of Origins

  • Collect 2000 Archeum Ore.

You can purchase these straight from the Auction House.

10. Tempered by the Flame

  • Use 30,000 Labor in Mining.

Celestial Dawnsdrop Pickaxe

11. Essence of Purity

  • Collect 200 Pure Iron Ore.

You can purchase these straight from the Auction House.

12. Further Refinement

  • Craft the Celestial Dawnsdrop Pickaxe at any Anvil.
Recipe Materials
